## Highlights

First release of **python-re3data-v2**, a from-scratch re-implementation of the archived
[python-re3data](https://github.com/afuetterer/python-re3data) targeting the current
re3data **v40 REST API** and **metadata schema 4.0** (August 2023), while keeping the
architecture and dict conventions of the original.

- **v40 endpoints**: `GET /api/v40/repositories` and `GET /api/v40/repository/{id}`
- **Typed schema 4.0 models**: hand-written dataclasses mirroring the official XSD — no `xsdata` dependency
- **Drift-tolerant parsing**: unknown vocabulary values and malformed dates never break a parse
- **Sync + async**: `Client` and `AsyncClient` on top of `httpx`
- **Flexible serialization**: `dataclass` · `dict` · `json` · `xml` · `csv` · `response`
- **Facet filters**: ~30 v40 filter facets via a single `filters` mapping
- **Minimal footprint**: Python 3.14+, the only runtime dependency is `httpx`

> [!WARNING]
> This is a pre-stable release — use with caution in production.

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/AstrayChao/python-re3data-v2/commits/v0.1.0>
